description: This file declares the RialtoConnector class, which manages session states and interactions with the Rialto server manager service, including initialization, session creation, suspension, resumption, deactivation, and state change handling within the WPEFramework namespace.

classes.name: RialtoConnector
classes.description: Manages Rialto server sessions and state changes, providing methods for session control and observing state transitions.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the RialtoConnector, setting up necessary services.

methods.name: initialized
methods.description: Returns whether the connector has been initialized.

methods.name: waitForStateChange
methods.description: Waits for a specific state change for a given application ID within a timeout period.

methods.name: createAppSession
methods.description: Creates a new application session with specified callsign, display name, and app ID.

methods.name: resumeSession
methods.description: Resumes a session identified by callsign.

methods.name: suspendSession
methods.description: Suspends a session identified by callsign.

methods.name: deactivateSession
methods.description: Deactivates a session identified by callsign.

methods.name: stateChanged
methods.description: Callback invoked when the state of an application changes.

methods.name: getCurrentAppState
methods.description: Retrieves the current state of an application based on callsign.
